channel.title: Swaya Changelog & Releases
channel.description: Full release history and update notes for Swaya on Windows 10/11 (v1.1.0 to v1.1.23): media organizer, link importer, and player updates.

item.title: Swaya v1.1.23 (Latest)
item.description: • Unified overlay layer stack and top-most dismissal ordering across modals, drawers, Lightbox (with FocusScope), dropdowns, split buttons, context menus, popovers, and tooltips • Cleaner player end-overlay state synchronization and layout-shift-free action button sizing in Organizer history cards alongside UI focus and theme refinements • Backend type-safety, FastAPI dependency, and linter hardening across artwork reconciliation, gallery endpoints, database maintenance, and link grabber services

item.title: Swaya v1.1.22 (Deletion UX & Cache)
item.description: • Three-mode gallery deletion (Remove from Library, Dissolve Album Only, or Recycle Bin / Permanent Delete) and explicit Library vs. Recycle Bin / disk photo deletion prompts across Lightbox and batch actions (for both managed and in-place files) • Scene detail hero showcase card with ambient blur framing for portrait and low-res covers, smoother poster card decoding, Cinema Catalog (F10) shortcut hint, and streamlined Library & Organizer controls • Cross-window Electron IPC query cache synchronization, optimistic UI updates with automatic rollback, and scoped cache invalidation for faster, flicker-free responsiveness

item.title: Swaya v1.1.19 (Media & Playback)
item.description: • Prune deleted upstream artworks during catalog delta sync while preserving custom uploads and local caches, and auto-heal confirmed 404/410 remote images in the UI • Faster local MPV playback startup with parallelized launch initialization, adaptive IPC polling, and single-seek resume • Classify static RedGIFs images, multi-photo RedGIFs galleries, and Reddit media viewer links as photos instead of videos

item.title: Swaya v1.1.18 (Core & Offline)
item.description: • Intercept rate-limited FansDB placeholder SVGs in Electron to prevent 24h cache poisoning, and retry transient card thumbnail loads with per-host concurrency limits • Keep local backend API queries and mutations active when offline using networkMode always • Modularized Link Grabber crawlers and ingestors, Gallery imports, Social sync, trailer proxy, and chunked Organizer batch preloading, plus fixed a tasks circular import

item.title: Swaya v1.1.17 (UI & Fixes)
item.description: • Unified titlebar toolbar button styling and icon alignment across SFW blur, Link Grabber, and Cinema Catalog camouflage toggles

item.title: Swaya v1.1.16 (Stability Patch)
item.description: • Action locking across scene cards, modals, downloads, settings, and forms to prevent accidental duplicate submissions • Refactored Electron and backend path configuration resolution, tray/player lifecycle, and updater error reporting • Stability improvements and codebase cleanup across catalog sync, file organizer, and UI hooks

item.title: Swaya v1.1.15 (Major Patch)
item.description: • Link Grabber All Media unified photo + video import with a spacious two-column modal layout • Background All Pages crawler for Coomer, Bunkr, and Lmlib with gallery merging, deduplication, and Cancel support • Gallery duplicate detection with 1-click switch, Ctrl+Enter submit shortcuts, and 12-language localization

item.title: Swaya v1.1.10 (Installer & Fixes)
item.description: • Improved catalog scroll restoration, remote trailer reliability, and updater restart handling • Expanded 12-language UI translations and visual polish across detail pages and filters

item.title: Swaya v1.1.0 (Initial Release)
item.description: • Initial Windows 10/11 desktop release with offline multi-provider catalog, smooth built-in player, and floating Picture-in-Picture • Automatic scene matching, batch file renaming with 1-click undo, F10 Camouflage mode, and 'B' soft blur
